h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tenali

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tenali

items.pText: In Tenali, many schools start with nursery and pre-primary classes, and those small children are often the ones who use the playground most. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, play schools and residential colonies in Tenali at our factory in Vasai East, about 890 km away in Maharashtra.

Tenali lies in the Krishna delta in Guntur district, a canal-fed farming area that is hot and humid for much of the year. The town also has a long tradition in theatre and the arts. We send the equipment by road and install it through our own team or a local dealer. Tell us how many small children use the ground at a time. We will suggest low, gentle pieces and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. The same drawing can show where equipment for the older classes should go later.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Equipment for nursery and pre-primary children

c: Children aged 2 to 5 need low platforms, short slides and handholds within easy reach. A small station such as
gives them climbing and sliding at a height they can manage. Spring riders and a
with bucket seats add movement at a gentle pace.

Keep the nursery play area apart from equipment for older children, ideally behind a low fence or hedge, so bigger children do not run through it. Teachers should be able to see every piece from one spot. Lay rubber flooring under everything, because small children fall often. Bright roto-moulded colours help young children find and name each piece.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 890 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What playground equipment suits children under five?
items.a: Low multi play stations, short slides, spring riders and toddler swings with bucket seats. Each should have handholds at a small child's reach and an impact-absorbing surface underneath.

items.q: Should the nursery play area be separate from the main playground?
items.a: Yes, where space allows. A separate corner with a low fence or hedge keeps older children from running through and lets teachers watch the younger ones easily.

items.q: Do you supply schools in Tenali?
items.a: Yes. After you approve the layout drawing and quote, we manufacture in Vasai, deliver by road and install with our own team or a local dealer.
